stop_confirm_text: The trip will end and the fare will be saved.
precise_needed_text: Approximate location is not accurate enough to measure a trip. Please allow precise location.
resume_text: A trip started at %1$s (%2$s so far) was interrupted. Resume it? Time while the app was closed is not counted.
disclaimer_short: Reference/estimate only. Not a Legal Metrology-approved fare meter.
earnings_note: Totals of metered fares stored on this phone only. Payments are not verified.
show_my_location: Show my location in Google Maps
location_unavailable: Could not get your location. Is GPS on?
estimate_hint: Read the driving distance in Google Maps and enter it below.
estimate_range_note: Range allows for a route up to 10% longer. Actual metered fare may differ.
pick_hint: Tap the map to choose your destination.
tariff_locked: Locked by the driver PIN while driver mode is on.
tariff_edit_note: Editing any value below switches to the Custom tariff.
f_night_waiting: Apply night multiplier to waiting charge
night_rule_any: Any part of trip is at night
meter_settings_note: Changes apply from the next trip.
ors_note: Optional. Free key from openrouteservice.org. Only the start and destination coordinates are sent, and only when you ask for an estimate.
tile_url_invalid: Must start with https:// and contain {z}, {x} and {y}.
tile_note: Respect the tile server's usage policy. The default OpenStreetMap server is for light use only.
driver_mode_text: Show a UPI payment QR when a trip ends.
pin_create_text: The PIN protects driver mode settings on this phone.
pin_locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in %d s.
upi_id_invalid: Enter a UPI ID like name@bank
upi_confirm_note: Confirm payment in your bank/UPI app before the passenger leaves. This app cannot verify payments.
disclaimer_full: Reference/estimate only. Not a Legal Metrology-approved fare meter. Fares as per the selected tariff preset.
disclaimer_more: GPS distance can differ from an approved meter. Check the tariff in Settings matches the current government notification.
disclosure_heading: Namma Meter uses your location to measure the trip
disclosure_body: To calculate the fare, the app reads your precise GPS location while the meter is running, including when the screen is off or you switch to another app. A notification is shown the whole time.
disclosure_point_1: Location is used only on this phone to measure distance and waiting time.
disclosure_point_2: It is not uploaded, sold or shared. No account, ads or analytics.
disclosure_point_3: Tracking stops when you press STOP.
disclosure_point_4: Notification permission lets you see the running fare outside the app.
permission_denied: Precise location was not allowed. The meter cannot run without it. You can allow it in app settings.
privacy_summary: All data stays on this phone. Location is used only for measuring trips. Nothing is sent anywhere, except optional distance queries to OpenRouteService (if you add a key) and map tiles when you open the map.
tariff_verify: Verify preset values against the official government order before relying on them.
